text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final. First Gulf is constructing a 24-storey office building at 25 Ontario Street. The site is located on the southeast corner of Adelaide Street East and Ontario Street. The east sidewalk and a 3.3 metre wide portion of the most easterly curb lane on Ontario Street is currently closed to accommodate a construction staging area. Toronto and East York Community Council at its meeting on June 18, 2020, approved the subject staging area on Ontario Street from June 19, 2020 to June 30, 2021. Toronto and East York Community Council approved the construction staging area for a period of one year, although the developer had indicated they would require the construction staging area until September 30, 2022.
